title: P15.9-B5.2: /app/system/business-admin + /app/workforce/admin legacy admin parity
description: Legacy Business-tab parity on existing canonical APIs only (zero backend/schema/dependency changes). /app/system/business-admin: create business with project_id verified against GET /api/projects (fail-closed when the project list is unavailable — never guessed), pinned ConfirmDialog on the exact payload, ambiguous-outcome wording on transport/5xx failure (no auto-retry, no fabricated success), inspect-by-id rendering the biz.detail() bundle (business/agents/objectives/routines/board work-item columns), global business list labeled global+unfiltered with select/inspect actions. /app/workforce/admin (bound to selected business, EmptyState when none): create org-agent (title+department+role+reports_to+executor_binding; backend auto-materializes baseline contract), create work-item (title+goal+department+assignee+objective+priority; never auto-opened), per-row open/block/unblock/comment through pinned dialogs (open labeled HIGH-IMPACT governed trigger), routine create + enable/disable (canonical mission_schedule seam), legacy objective create explicitly labeled LEGACY compat vs vnext. All mutation dialogs pin {op,biz,target,payload} at open, are invalidated on business change, dup-submit guarded (dblclick → exactly 1 POST), canonical refetch after success, ambiguous wording on transport failure. Same-business-only selects make cross-business reports_to/assignee/objective un-submittable from the UI (backend FAIL_CLOSED_*_SCOPE still authoritative). apiAdmin wrappers added (projects raw array shape verified against server; noAuthPrompt everywhere; reads take AbortSignal). New e2e spec workforce-admin.spec.ts covering the 19-item verification list incl. network-level proof that /app/company reads the newly selected business_id and unauthenticated fail-closed. R1 audit fixes: (F1) SPA business switch synchronously wipes all business-dependent forms (agent/WI/routine/objective) and submit() revalidates reports_to/assignee_agent_id/objective_id against the CURRENT selected-business lists — stale or cross-business selection rejected client-side, backend FAIL_CLOSED_*_SCOPE stays authoritative; (F2) business-admin inspect clears the previous detail payload synchronously, shows a pinned LOADING row, verifies returned business_id === requested id before rendering (mismatch → error, never shown), out-of-order late responses discarded; (F3) sect() validates envelopes before nested reads — null/primitive/non-array 200 payloads → UNAVAILABLE (MALFORMED), never an empty canonical list, pick() runs once, malformed primary agents read → fatal MALFORMED error not an empty global list. Proof: tsc+vite PASS; playwright workforce-admin 11/11.
